answer_1.quote: The task aims to recommend proper items to users through natural language conversations, and the model-generated conversation is expected to be fluent and suit the context.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate dialogue performance, we report perplexity (PPL) and distinct n-grams (DIST), assessing the fluency and the diversity of generated responses, respectively.

answer_4.quote: We engaged three annotators who were tasked with assessing model outputs given a dialogue history.
answer_4.guideline: The following instructions were provided to guide annotators in their assessments: Fluency: ... avoiding grammatical flaws. Informativeness: ... accuracy of the conveyed information. Coherence: ... natural conversational flow.
